title.narrative: Towards a liquid, flexible and transparent global Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) market

description.narrative: This action aims to contribute to the EU Energy Union objectives, in particular on secure, diverse and competitive gas supplies by supporting the establishment of a liquid, flexible and transparent global LNG market. The action will further implement the international dimension of the EU Strategy for LNG and Gas Storage. This objective will be achieved by deepening engagement with LNG importing and exporting countries and by creating greater awareness, understanding and consensus on the subject, among major and emerging LNG producer and consumer countries, based on best practices in EU policy and regulations and functioning of EU gas markets.
